unit: per form; sibling forms are never pooled for editorial eligibility

classes.reference-dependent: every form clears the reference-loaded gates but at least one form misses a cold gate
classes.not-ready: at least one form misses a reference-loaded gate or the instrument refuses

interpretation: This is an agent-reader editorial screen, not human validation and not ratification evidence. Passing identifies examples suitable for further website judgment; failing does not withdraw a construct by itself.
